helpers.name: Render_UploadPaletteBand1
helpers.behavior: Uploads 16 palette words to the second VDP palette band and records the source pointer at 0x00FF7266.

helpers.name: Render_UploadPaletteBand2
helpers.behavior: Uploads 16 palette words to the third VDP palette band and records the source pointer at 0x00FF726A.

helpers.name: Render_UploadPaletteBand0
helpers.behavior: Uploads 16 palette words to the first VDP palette band and records the source pointer at 0x00FF7262.

helpers.name: Render_UploadPaletteBand3
helpers.behavior: Uploads 16 palette words to the fourth VDP palette band and records the source pointer at 0x00FF726E.

helpers.name: Render_ReloadPaletteBands
helpers.behavior: Re-uploads all four published palette bands through the individual VDP upload helpers while preserving the caller's A0 register.

helpers.name: Render_ClearPalette
helpers.behavior: Writes zero to all 64 palette words at the VDP palette destination.

helpers.name: Render_ApplyPaletteBandStep
helpers.behavior: Converges a caller-selected 16-word palette band toward the current palette one component group at a time, writes the band to VDP, and records the source pointer at 0x00FF7262.

helpers.name: Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom
helpers.behavior: Initializes four palette-band pointers from a caller-supplied palette, snapshots current VDP palette state, and runs 16 VBlank-paced palette convergence steps.

helpers.name: Scene_ApplyActiveLevelPaletteTransition
helpers.behavior: Selects the active level record from SCENE_STATE in the ROM level table, stores its palette source, and invokes the shared palette transition using that source.

conclusion: The palette subsystem has all four reusable band upload primitives, a full clear primitive, parameterized and fixed-source transition loops, a palette-band reload primitive, and a named scene entry that selects the active level palette source.
